summary: Iteration 8: Tested the rename to Halifax Youth Hub, guest resume gating, carrying a guest draft over at signup, AI summary and AI bullets (real Claude calls), ?next login/register redirects, and checked that the other pages still load. Backend: 9 of 10 pytest tests pass. Frontend: all requested flows pass. One logic bug: an empty junk resume is created when a guest visits /resume without typing and then logs in. One minor backend bug: an invalid resume id returns 500.

minor.issue: A resume_id that is not a valid ObjectId (e.g. 'not-an-objectid') raises bson InvalidId, so the API returns 500 instead of 400/404. Wrap ObjectId() in a validator.

integration_issues.issue: ResumeBuilderPage.jsx line 52-54 writes the EMPTY resume to localStorage 'hyh_resume_draft' on every guest visit, even if the guest typed nothing. When that person later logs in and opens /resume, the effect at line 62-72 POSTs an empty 'My Resume', shows the toast 'Your draft was saved to your account' and opens the empty resume instead of their existing one. Reproduced: a user who already had resume TEST_Existing visited /resume as a guest without typing, logged in via /login?next=/resume, and ended up with ['TEST_Existing', 'My Resume'] with the empty resume selected.

action_items: ResumeBuilderPage: only save the guest draft (or only auto-POST it after login) when it differs from EMPTY, e.g. full_name/summary/headline/skills/experience/education is non-empty. Otherwise just remove the key and load the existing resumes.
Backend: return 400/404 for an invalid ObjectId in /api/resumes/{id} PUT/DELETE (and in any other ObjectId(...) path params).
/app/memory/test_credentials.md: testuser@halifaxyouth.ca / Test1234! returns 401 Invalid credentials. Seed the account or update the file.
critical_code_review_comments: Junk-draft bug described above (the draft is saved without checking whether it is empty).

If a logged-in user who already has resumes registers or logs in with a draft, the draft becomes a new resume, which is fine. But the auto-POST has no .catch, so if it fails the draft is lost silently, because localStorage.removeItem runs before the POST.
ai_summary does its emergentintegrations import without try/except, unlike ai_assist. If the import fails, it raises an unhandled 500.
aiAssist shows the generic 'AI request failed' message and ignores the backend detail. aiSummary shows the detail.
seed_data_creation: Registered TEST users test_it8_*, test_gate_*, test_nonext_*, test_junk_* @example.com, with TEST resumes in their own accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: the tab title, brand-link and footer show Halifax Youth Hub / HALIFAXYOUTHHUB. Guests can open /resume, see the banner and live preview, and every gated action (save, print, ai-summary, ai-assist-0) opens resume-signup-gate with the correct hrefs. The draft persists across reload. Registering via gate-register returns to /resume?id=..., shows the toast and the My resumes list, and clears localStorage. AI summary writes text and ai-assist returns 4 bullets; Add appends a bullet to the preview, and Save works. Login and register without ?next go to /dashboard. The links between login and register keep ?next (URL-encoded as %2Fresume). Programs, jobs, events and dashboard all load. Retest: the junk-draft fix and invalid ObjectId handling.
rca of the issue: Junk resume: useEffect([user, resume]) persists the resume state for any guest, including the untouched EMPTY default. The authed effect treats any localStorage draft as real work and POSTs it. Fix: skip the save or POST when the draft has no user-entered content.
